Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 21-Nov-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  
  FIFTH SEMESTER B.TECH. (COMPUTER SCEINCE & ENGINEERING/ INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY) EXAMINATIONS -  
  NOVEMBER 2024  
  SUBJECT: HUM 3022/HUM_3122/HUM_3022 - ESSENTIALS OF MANAGEMENT  
  ESSENTIALS OF MANAGEMENT [HUM 3022]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                              Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)   Different managerial activities are listed in the table below. With reference to Mintzberg's managerial roles, mention the role   (4)  
  category and specific role for the following activities.  
  
  
1B)               Compare and contrast the managerial practices in Japan and the USA, focusing on cultural influences and         (3)  
  organizational behavior.  
1C)               Five years ago, Mr. Rahul Modi completed his degree in food processing. He worked for one year in a             (3)  
  company manufacturing noodles, masala powders, and pasta. He was not happy in the company and  
  decided to have his own organic food processing unit for the same. He set the objectives and the targets  
  and formulated an action plan to achieve the same. One of his objectives was to earn a 10% profit on the  
  amount invested in the first year. It was also decided that raw materials like fruits, vegetables, spices, etc.  
  will be purchased on three months' credit from farmers cultivating organic crops only. He also decided to  
  follow the steps required for marketing the products through his own outlets. He appointed Ms. Mamta Patel  
  as a production manager who decides the exact manner in which the production activities are to be carried  
  out. Ms. Mamta Patel also prepared a statement showing the number of workers that will be required in the  
  factory throughout the year. Mr. Rahul Modi informed Ms. Mamta Patel about his sales target for different  
  products, area-wise for the forthcoming quarter. While working on the production table a penalty of 100  
  rupees per day for not wearing the caps, gloves, and apron was announced.  
  Question to be answered:  
  Quoting lines from the above paragraph, outline any four types of plans discussed, and briefly explain them.  
2A)               As the leader of the organization, you are inevitably responsible for the direction and development of your     (4)  
  organization. With this regard, it is important to consistently design a strategic plan for your operations.  
  Proficiency in several tools and methodologies is necessary to accomplish this task. Using appropriate  
  representation and examples, discuss any two strategic tools that you will implement to facilitate the  
  development of your firm.  
2B)               Explain the nature and purpose of organizing function in management. Also discuss the steps in organizing       (3)  
  
  with a suitable representation.  
2C)               Propose a scheme of departmentation for a MNC with a field network of sales all over the country. Discuss       (3)  
  its merits and limitations.  
  Page 1 of 2

its merits and limitations.  
3A)   A new team leader in the customer service department is training an employee to handle customer                   (3)  
  escalations independently. Following the Flow of Delegation model, analyze how the team leader would  
  apply each step in training the employee on handling escalated calls.  
3B)   Analyze the differences between Human Resource Management (HRM) and Human Resource                                (3)  
  Development (HRD). How do these functions complement each other in achieving long-term organizational  
  success?  
3C)   Analyze McGregor's THEORY X AND THEORY Y motivational theory that guides the Manager to develop                   (4)  
  strategies to motivate his/her employees toward organizational goals. Give corporate examples for the  
  same.  
4A)   Evaluate three types of recruitment methods commonly used by modern businesses. For each method,                  (3)  
  provide relevant examples and assess how it aligns with organizational goals and talent needs.  
4B)   Identify and examine three current trends in Training & Development. For each trend, analyze its potential        (3)  
  impact on employee performance and organizational growth, providing examples from recent industry  
  practices.  
4C)   TechNova Corporation is a rapidly growing software development company that has expanded into various             (4)  
  sectors, including mobile applications, cloud services, and cybersecurity. The company has two main  
  departments: Product Development and Technical Support.  
  
  The Product Development team consists of creative software engineers and designers who work  
  collaboratively on innovative projects. Recently, the team has expressed frustration with strict guidelines and  
  constant oversight from their manager. They believe their creativity is stifled, and they could produce better  
  results if given more freedom to explore their ideas. The team flourishes on brainstorming sessions and  
  values input from all members.  
  
  The Technical Support department handles customer inquiries and troubleshooting issues. The team works  
  in a fast-paced environment, where quick responses are essential to maintaining customer satisfaction. The  
  manager has been directive and emphasizes adherence to scripts and procedures, ensuring all team  
  members follow the same protocol for handling customer issues.  
  
  Based on the scenarios presented for each department, identify which leadership style would be most  
  suitable for each department and justify your reasoning. Consider the unique needs and dynamics of the  
  teams when providing your analysis  
5A)   How can 'systems approach to staffing' help the HR managers' activities of a manufacturing plant? Provide a (3)  
  labeled sketch to illustrate its main components.  
5B)   In a technology organization, various barriers can hinder effective communication among team members.             (3)  
  Identify and discuss three common barriers to effective communication in the workplace and suggest ways  
  to address them.  
5C)   TechGear is a mid-sized manufacturer specializing in high-quality consumer electronics, including             (4)  
  smartwatches and fitness trackers. The company has recently advertised the launch of a new smartwatch  
  model that includes advanced health monitoring features. The market response has been overwhelmingly  
  positive, leading to a significant increase in orders. The supply chain manager proactively orders additional  
  components and materials needed for production. The human resources team hires 25 temporary workers  
  and schedules 3 hours of overtime for existing employees to ramp up production capacity. As the launch  
  date of the new smartwatch approaches, the marketing team at TechGear conducts extensive market  
  research. They project that the demand will exceed the company's planned production capacity (2000 units)  
  due to high pre-orders and promotional activities. After launching the smartwatch, 850 customers provided  
  feedback through surveys and online reviews. While most feedback is positive, some customers report  
  issues with battery life and software glitches, which affected the company's goal of 100 % customer  
  satisfaction. The product development team analyzed customer feedback and identified that a software  
  update is needed to fix the glitches, and there is a need to enhance battery optimization in the next  
  production run starting in the 1st week of March. The engineering team develops a software patch and  
  begins working on hardware changes for the next iteration of the smartwatch.  
  
  
  Questions to be answered:  
  a) Identify and explain the TWO types of control being practiced by quoting the lines.  
  b) Identify and explain TWO critical point standards by quoting the line.
